utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s this Saturday on the front porch, and folks can bring any small fix-it items they need help with.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s right — this Saturday on the front porch. Thanks for helping spread the word, Jules.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll let the neighbors know, and if anyone wants to help out, I could use a few extra hands too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I could use another pair of hands at the front porch this Saturday, especially for setting out supplies and checking off donations.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let everyone know you need another pair of hands at the front porch Saturday, and once I have the missing list I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. If you can also bring a clipboard and a pen, that would help me keep the donations checked off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think we could use about four people total. Mostly just a few small fixes, but I’d like an extra pair of hands at the porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—do you need me there Saturday, and if so, what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please come by Saturday around 10 a.m. at the front porch. An extra pair of hands would really help with the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — just a quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. Hope that still works for you!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks for the update, Rosa — Sunday at the community center should work, but I’ll need the exact drop-off details so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll send the drop-off details once I’ve got them finalized. Thanks for being flexible, Pia!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — could you help me check who still needs tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll check who still needs tools or supplies and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. Let me know if anyone still needs anything, and I’ll get it ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver by the repair drive spot soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — the front porch is the spot, and we could use help sorting items and small fixes this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — front porch this Saturday, and I’ll help sort and fix things if I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: This Saturday morning at the front porch—come by anytime after 9, and if you can help sort things, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll stop by after 9 on Saturday and help sort things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Leo—that’d be a big help. I’ll have coffee on and the boxes ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Nell — if you hear anything, just let me know. I’m organizing it for Saturday at the front porch, and I could use a few helpers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’ll keep listening and let you know if I hear anything about helpers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—what still needs fixing for the repair drive? Just remind me what you still need from me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still keeping an ear out for the latest updates, but I could really use your help this Saturday on the front porch if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday on the front porch works for me—what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks for the update, Hana — I can bring some screws and a few tools by on Sunday. Just let me know what else would help at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — the repair drive is this Saturday at the front porch, not Sunday. Could you bring those screws and tools then, and I’ll let you know if anything else is needed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — Saturday at the front porch. I’ll bring the screws and tools then, and just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still happening today at the front porch. I’m just checking my list—where did you last see the tools and spare parts?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes—last I saw the tools and spare parts were by the front porch. Just to confirm, that’s still where folks should drop things off, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still setting up the repair drive for Saturday at the front porch. If you can help, I could really use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — the repair drive is actually Sunday at the community center now, and I could still use a few more tools and screws if you have any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, thanks for the update, Cleo — Sunday at the community center works. I can bring a few tools and some screws to help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I could use help sorting supplies and setting up the porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can help sort supplies and set up the porch this Saturday. I’ll swing by the front porch repair drive spot with a hammer and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Bo — thanks! A hammer and screwdriver will really help, and sorting supplies at the porch would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I could use a few helpers on Saturday at the front porch, and maybe someone to spread the word. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I could use that help on Saturday—if you can spread the word and maybe lend a hand at the porch, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be great, thanks—please come by the front porch Saturday morning, and if you can, let a few neighbors know too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and let folks know it’s for the repair drive, and I’ll follow up with the exact time and place soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. It’s now on Sunday at the community center, so please share that with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll spread the word that it’s this Sunday at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What still needs fixing for the repair drive? I can bring the screws by and help out too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks — we still need to sort out the loose fence panel and that squeaky gate. I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact time, but I’ll check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the fence panel and gate on Saturday. Just send me the time when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the date, time, and exact location for the repair drive so I can share it correctly?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s this Saturday at the front porch. I’m still sorting out the time, so I’ll send that as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — so it’s this Saturday at the front porch, and you’ll send the time later, right? I’ll hold off sharing it until I have that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with whatever’s needed at the repair drive — what should I grab?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Dane — if you can bring a few basic tools, some tape, and a box for small parts, that’d be a big help. If you hear from anyone else, please let them know it’s this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring basic tools, tape, and a box for small parts. I’ll also pass along that it’s this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I could still use a couple of helpers if you know anyone handy. If you’ve got donations, bringing them by sooner rather than later would really help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and see if I can bring a couple of handy neighbors. I’ll tell folks to drop donations by sooner rather than later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate you spreading the word. If you hear of anyone free Saturday, send them my way, and I’ll keep folks posted on any new donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m organizing it for this Saturday on the front porch. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not much yet—just figuring out what still needs fixing and who’s bringing what. Once the details are set, I’ll pass them along and keep everyone updated.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you tell me who’s already committed, and what tools or supplies we still need?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I still need a couple helpers and whatever tools or spare parts people can spare. I’ll check the list by the front steps again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’m glad you’re checking the list. I just want to make sure everyone knows it’s this Saturday at the front porch, so no one shows up at the wrong time or place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right, this Saturday at the front porch for the tool and spare-part drop-off. I’ll make sure the list is clear and the spot is marked.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still waiting on the latest, but I’ll keep an ear out for updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — it’s Sunday at the community center now, and I could still use a few more tools and screws if you have any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can’t promise any tools or screws, but I’ll keep an ear out for anything useful and let you know if I hear more about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks for the update, Cleo — I’ll keep an eye out for any tools or screws while I’m out and pass them along if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t got the repair drive on my list yet—where did you last see it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Last I heard, it’s Sunday at the community center, and Cleo still needs a few more tools and screws. I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, still on — Saturday, at the front porch. If you can, I could really use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — Saturday at the front porch, confirmed. I might stop by if I can help.
